욥기 10:1.content: My soul is weary of my life; I will leave my complaint upon myself; I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.

욥기 10:2.content: I will say unto God, Do not condemn me; shew me wherefore thou contendest with me.

욥기 10:3.content: Is it good unto thee that thou shouldest oppress, that thou shouldest despise the work of thine hands, and shine upon the counsel of the wicked?

욥기 10:4.content: Hast thou eyes of flesh? or seest thou as man seeth?

욥기 10:5.content: Are thy days as the days of man? are thy years as man’s days,

욥기 10:6.content: That thou enquirest after mine iniquity, and searchest after my sin?

욥기 10:7.content: Thou knowest that I am not wicked; and there is none that can deliver out of thine hand.

욥기 10:8.content: Thine hands have made me and fashioned me together round about; yet thou dost destroy me.

욥기 10:9.content: Remember, I beseech thee, that thou hast made me as the clay; and wilt thou bring me into dust again?

욥기 10:10.content: Hast thou not poured me out as milk, and curdled me like cheese?

욥기 10:11.content: Thou hast clothed me with skin and flesh, and hast fenced me with bones and sinews.

욥기 10:12.content: Thou hast granted me life and favour, and thy visitation hath preserved my spirit.

욥기 10:13.content: And these things hast thou hid in thine heart: I know that this is with thee.

욥기 10:14.content: If I sin, then thou markest me, and thou wilt not acquit me from mine iniquity.

욥기 10:15.content: If I be wicked, woe unto me; and if I be righteous, yet will I not lift up my head. I am full of confusion; therefore see thou mine affliction;

욥기 10:16.content: For it increaseth. Thou huntest me as a fierce lion: and again thou shewest thyself marvellous upon me.

욥기 10:17.content: Thou renewest thy witnesses against me, and increasest thine indignation upon me; changes and war are against me.

욥기 10:18.content: Wherefore then hast thou brought me forth out of the womb? Oh that I had given up the ghost, and no eye had seen me!

욥기 10:19.content: I should have been as though I had not been; I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.

욥기 10:20.content: Are not my days few? cease then, and let me alone, that I may take comfort a little,

욥기 10:21.content: Before I go whence I shall not return, even to the land of darkness and the shadow of death;

욥기 10:22.content: A land of darkness, as darkness itself; and of the shadow of death, without any order, and where the light is as darkness.
